shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat (typed bridges, clean signatures); Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only, zero typerefs).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only. Modern Suite parity contract for any styled UI.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x, no power link, rotatable edge-hugging), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend shaft gizmos, ground car holds both links, two-hop rides auto-continue).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x settings slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses the far side, no refund; reinstall spawns fresh). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops.
- All consumers resolve links via CounterpartTowards(map); stair jobs carry their exit in targetC.

## Systems (T0-T10 all verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- See-below renderer: whitelisted layers incl. water depth, air-cells light mask (night cap 0.45), silhouettes suppressed, ceiling hints, far clip 70.
- Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels; surface sync sole driver.
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch WorkGiver + demand pull (construction, bill shortfalls with aggregated alternatives, patient/prisoner meals) + export pinning + deterministic carried-cargo delivery after transfer.
- Needs: rest routes to owned bed anywhere in column (two-hop) or free bed on linked level; food redirect for colonists and eligible pets.
- Medical/prisoners: cross-level rescue WorkGiver + capture float order via CarriedIntent continuations (land at exit, queued vanilla Rescue/Capture).
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels (+ ghouls in Schedule only, Animals tab patched separately); colonist bar groups ordered sky/surface/basement per column; level view buttons in the vanilla global controls row (relocated from a floating panel after playtest collision; toggleable); camera preserves precise sub-cell position and zoom; beds alert aggregates the column.
- Power/pipes/climate bridge per link (elevator second link included).
- Cross-map ordered work: ABPendingOrders stashes an action + target map, replayed by StairTransfer on arrival (job queues do not survive despawn).

## Compat
- DBH water + VEF PipeSystem: equalization bridges, load-verified + DBH live-verified.
- Reverse Commands (brrainz.reversecommands): their reversed float menu now lists colonists from directly linked levels. Candidates are virtually placed at their stairwell exit, vanilla options gathered exactly like their local flow (selector juggled via FieldRef, GetOptions out-context), each option.action wrapped to route through stairs then replay via ABPendingOrders; their PathInfo cache seeded by reflection so the pick-menu sort cannot NRE. Inert without the mod; needs a companion-mod test run.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/ledge rock on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim over air (cosmetic); bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples counted as singles in beds alert; Reverse Commands scope is directly linked levels only (two-hop pawns excluded).
- Threat policy: pocket levels raid-free; opt-ins slated for T8.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE and verified in-game (2026-07-19). Reverse Commands compat CODE DONE, pending a companion run.
- Next: T5 publishing prep (field manual, Steam description + Quality Commitment block, Preview.png, dependency audit, publish-hold, final regression with and without companions).
- Backlog: T8 threat opt-ins, T9 pipe depth, T11 world integration.

## Status
All tranches through T10 verified. RC compat awaiting a companion-mod test run, then T5 publishing prep.
